one_line_reason: Multiple recent meta-analyses of Cynara scolymus (artichoke) supplementation show consistent effects across cardiometabolic outcomes (blood pressure, lipids, glucose, liver enzymes, waist circumference) -- exactly what artichoke supplements are marketed for.

selected.population: adults (systematic review and meta-analysis of RCTs, multiple studies pooled)
selected.intervention: artichoke (Cynara scolymus) supplementation, oral, vs placebo/control
selected.primary_outcome: cardiometabolic markers: BMI, waist circumference, blood pressure, lipid profile, insulin/HOMA-IR
selected.why_selected: The most comprehensive and recent (2025) meta-analysis, with significant reductions in BMI, waist circumference, systolic/diastolic blood pressure, total cholesterol, LDL-C, triglycerides, and insulin/HOMA-IR

selected.population: adults across 10 pooled RCTs, with a hypertensive subgroup analysis
selected.intervention: Cynara scolymus supplementation, oral, dose-response meta-analysis
selected.dose_as_stated: not stated (dose-response analysis across multiple doses)
selected.why_selected: Independent dose-response meta-analysis showing a significant overall waist-circumference reduction, with body weight only significantly reduced in the hypertensive-patient subgroup, not overall

selected.population: adults across 8 pooled clinical trials, including NAFLD and overweight/obese subgroups
selected.intervention: Cynara scolymus supplementation, oral, vs placebo
selected.why_selected: Significant AST/ALT reductions overall, with the strongest effect in patients with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease

selected.population: 55 overweight subjects with newly diagnosed impaired fasting glycaemia
selected.intervention: standardized Cynara scolymus extract 600 mg/day, oral, 8 weeks vs placebo
selected.why_selected: Clean single-ingredient, dose-stated RCT showing significant improvements in fasting glucose, HOMA, HbA1c, and lipid pattern in a general at-risk (prediabetic, non-drug-treated) population

blockers: None of the three meta-analyses states a single consistent oral dose in the abstract, and several beneficial subgroup effects (weight loss, liver enzymes) are concentrated in hypertensive or NAFLD patient subgroups rather than the general population
23440660 uses a specific standardized 600 mg/day extract; catalog artichoke products in other forms (leaf powder, whole extract) may not match this exact preparation

excluded_pmids.reason: Meta-analysis (9 RCTs) of artichoke on glycemic indices found a significant fasting-blood-sugar reduction but non-significant effects on insulin, HOMA-IR, and HbA1c; excluded from the 4-item cap as largely redundant with the glycemic finding already captured by 23440660 and 41270328
RCT of Cynara scolymus 500 mg twice daily as an adjunct to captopril in hypertensive patients; combination with a prescription antihypertensive drug in a clinical population
Combination of Phaseolus vulgaris (white kidney bean) and Cynara scolymus extracts for appetite/glycemia; not an isolated artichoke exposure
Eufortyn® Colesterolo Plus is a 4-ingredient nutraceutical (bergamot polyphenol phytosome, artichoke extract, CoQ10 phytosome, zinc); combination product, not isolated artichoke
Review of Persian herbal medicine for functional dyspepsia covering 15 different herbs and 4 compound remedies; artichoke (Cynara scolymus) is one of many, not isolated
Meta-analysis is of animal studies; only 2 human studies were narratively reviewed and found 'no change or a slight improvement,' too sparse and inconclusive to select as primary human evidence

Older (2003) review of 4 cholesterol-lowering herbs (guggul, fenugreek, red yeast rice, artichoke) pooled together; superseded by the artichoke-specific meta-analyses already selected (41270328, 34383355)

Systematic review of alcohol hangover interventions; the retrieved abstract text does not confirm artichoke was among the specific agents tested (propranolol, tropisetron, tolfenamic acid, fructose/glucose named; remainder truncated)
